criterion: C: verified solved count (more is better), then total actual CPU consumed (timeouts counted at the CPU they actually consumed; a resource amount, not a completion time)
training_pool: discovery + development (528), grouped by base problem (each base problem its own group), folds stratified by family x level
fold_order: within each family x level cell, instances sorted by sha256(id + ':v11fold'); outer fold = rank mod 5; inner fold = rank among the training instances of the cell mod 3
static_features: the 20 static10 features of scripts/cross_scale_v10/common.py STATIC
prefix_features: STATIC + D prefix (ARM + neg_dec) = v10 family B

SBS.rule: best fixed action on the training fold by C (static cost not charged)

V10.rule: frozen v10 main strategy configs/cross_scale_v10/frozen/main.json, not retrained (historical)

ST.rule: cost-sensitive tree on the static features of all training instances; split objective = C summed over leaves with each leaf's best action; a leaf deviates from the training SBS only if its best action solves no fewer leaf instances and its leaf total CPU <= (1 - theta) x the SBS leaf total; costs include the static analysis

TR.rule: Gini classification tree on the static features predicting the generating family (family labels are training targets only); a leaf maps to its majority family's best fixed action on the training fold (by C), or to the training SBS if its purity < purity_min; out-of-range check on all 20 static features (training [min, max] widened by range_expand_fraction of the range on each side; missing = out of range) -> training SBS

PR.rule: v10 family B reader code (scripts/cross_scale_v10/devlib.fit_reader): base = best fixed action on the training instances the prefix did not answer; missing (prefix did not reach search) -> base; ridge on censored CPU differences with margin in seconds; tree depth 2/3, min leaf 5, threshold quantiles 0.25/0.5/0.75, margin in seconds per instance

NC.rule: matched content-free control of PR: the D prefix of the tau chosen by PR in the same (outer or final) fit, then the PR base (best fixed action on the training instances the prefix did not answer); reads no content

replace_rule: a later family replaces the incumbent if it has more OOF solved, or equal solved and OOF total CPU <= (1 - replace_margin) x the incumbent's; PR must also beat NC by the same rule
inner_tie_rule: inner CV: best by C; configurations within 1% of the best total at the same solved count are tied; ties -> lower mean observation cost, then grid order
structural_control: S* = the better of ST and TR by OOF C
deploy: V10 (original v10 wrapper and frozen file)
diagnostics: oracle family-label routing (posthoc upper bound, not deployable)

bootstrap.strata: block x family x level (confirmation) / family x level (pool)
